detailed_descriptions_html.en:
※ This content requires the base game (DragonSword : Awakening) to play.

[Contents]
- Costume : White Flower of the Blue Waves
- Weapon Appearance : Petals at the Wave's Edge

[Costume : White Flower of the Blue Waves]
Reina's summer outfit, where white flower ornaments meet blue waves.
Like a flower blooming on calm waters, it is serene yet impossible to look away from.

[Weapon Appearance : Petals at the Wave's Edge]
Reina's weapon, resembling flower petals scattering at the edge of the waves.
It seems to brush by gently, but its edge is far colder than you'd expect.

[How to Obtain In-Game After Purchasing the Costume DLC]
1. Press "ESC" on the keyboard or the "≡" button on the gamepad to enter the "Main Menu"
2. Select the "Hero" menu
3. Select the character of the purchased costume
4. Select the hanger-shaped icon at the bottom left
5. Select and equip the outfit you want
※ If purchased while the game is running, it can be confirmed after restarting the game.
※ Costumes can be used after obtaining the corresponding hero. Heroes can be obtained by completing quests or through the Exchange.
